evidence.why: Registers the three callbacks in the sole table entry.
Shows charge-derived animation outputs, completion test, exact velocity writes and inert collision.

facts.rationale: Corrects the existing implication that the physics callback enforces complete stationarity. Spawn initializes all velocity components to zero, but the per-state physics assignment writes Z, Y and Z again, never X.
facts.value: Supplies the item state system with the animation, physics and collision callbacks for the PK Flash explosion's motion state 0. Animation consumes stored charge and special attributes to update model scale, hitbox scale, damage and completion. Physics clears only vertical and depth velocity, leaving horizontal velocity unchanged; collision always returns false without processing the item.
